svg.text: Layout A: inline setup in the list banner slot
Every token state uses the slot where web/Banner.tsx sits today, at the top of the PR or Issues list pane. Notices expand in place to show the fix.
Required scope or token missing: alert card, sync paused, cached list dimmed. Project scope missing: one quiet line on the Issues list, the rest works.
Check again re-reads the token with gh auth token and re-checks X-OAuth-Scopes, no restart. Nothing new in Settings.
A1 Desktop 1660x870: required scope missing (PRs)
Card replaces the old error banner. Copy and Check again sit next to the command. Detail panes unchanged.
